name: paperpulse-skill
title_zh: 一篇论文 PDF 变成带原图截图的中文解读页
tagline_zh: 读完摘要还是不知道它到底证明了什么？它把论文里的原图原表截下来贴进中文解读，论点、证据、批判各归各位。
tagline_en: Still unsure what the paper actually proves? It screenshots the original figures and tables into a Chinese.
desc_en: Turn one local CS, AI, or LLM paper PDF into a Chinese, screenshot-backed research brief and a shareable HTML page. Use when readers need the paper's argument, original figures or tables, evidence, and a grounded critique—not for generic PDF extraction or literature searches.
why_zh: 解读里的每张图都来自 PDF 原文截图，不是重画也不是转述，所以你能对着原图核对作者到底画了什么。
why_en: Every figure in the brief is a screenshot from the original PDF—not redrawn, not paraphrased—so you can check the claim against.
limit_zh: 只吃本地单篇 CS/AI/LLM 论文 PDF，不做文献检索、不做多篇综述。
limit_en: One local CS/AI/LLM paper PDF only—no literature search, no multi-paper review. Scanned or image-only PDFs without a text layer fail outright.
title_en: One paper PDF into a Chinese brief with original figures
